architect_disposition: approved bounded direct repair because the normal SAGE control path is the failed subject

observed_failure.primary: The lower-level request-planning CLI published request execution as the next external continuation even though request execution requires a checksum-bound Architect objective-path decision that had not been produced.
observed_failure.recovery: After the exact retry, recovery classified unchanged local non-convergence as successor-action/Architect attention even though accepted_control_failure=false, producing a boundary its own improvement-action consumer rejected.

causal_analysis: The objective-path authority gate was introduced as a use-case-local/front-door change rather than propagated as a lifecycle-wide producer/consumer invariant.
Component tests proved planning, the authority gate, execution, and front-door behavior individually but did not prove that every published route into mutation satisfied the gate.
This is evidence against persistent-LLM freelancing: local solutioning can be internally coherent while leaving other published compositions inconsistent.
repair_scope: Return confirmed semantic-bootstrap sources to the intent-to-outcome lifecycle owner before planning-to-mutation progression.
Keep request-plan/request-execute as reusable component interfaces but remove their authority to advertise an external lifecycle continuation that bypasses objective-path approval.
Preserve the existing request-execution objective-path gate and exact proposal binding.
Restore the accepted recovery invariant that non-convergence/recurrence without evidence-backed accepted-control failure cannot create a successor Architect boundary.
Add a route-level lifecycle contract self-test spanning semantic bootstrap, planning, authority, execution, and recovery.
out_of_scope: proactive repair of other workflows not shown to fail
future_trigger: If another later-added cross-cutting lifecycle invariant is found to have path-local implementation or incomplete route coverage, use this record as comparable evidence and consider a separate bounded systemic action only when recurrence justifies it.
reentry: After deterministic validation passes, resume the original agent-isolation objective through the lifecycle-owned confirmed-source adoption boundary.
